title: A voice switch the database cannot read for a while does not end live voice sessions; Voice off mid-phrase sends no partial
steps: S1: a live relay session whose ui_setting read starts failing.
S2: a reading (say) under way whose switch read fails, then the switch turns off.
S3: the switch turns off while a phrase is pending.
expect: S2: the reading keeps running while the read fails, and is cut when the switch reads false.
S3: the session ends 'stopped' with settled false.
S4: the end reason is 'provider', not 'provider-busy'.
evidence: Review 19/10/2026: every live session queried ui_setting each second and ended on any query error
fence: Only an explicit false from the switch ends a running voice session

tests: a running session outlives a voice switch the database cannot read for a while
Voice turned off mid-phrase ends the session as unconfirmed, so the page does not send the partial
a reading under way outlives a voice switch the database cannot read; Voice turned off still cuts it
the service's errors end the session with a reason the page can word
